column1: 36 numbered interfaces with 32 systems. ACE ingests every inbound source and the Workbench reads it through the read-only v_ace_* views. The Workbench owns its outbound files, the reporting feeds and the partner portal; SMS, LINE and the audit and security logs (INT-17, INT-18, INT-22) leave through paths the ACE team owns. No component calls a system of record directly. INT-35 (NLEADS credit decision) and INT-36 (EasyApp e-signature) are the two new ACE inbound interfaces raised in RWB-ACE-001.
